# Locusify

> Locusify turns geotagged travel photos into interactive route maps and animated journey replays. Photo parsing and map rendering happen locally on the user's device.

## Primary pages

- Chinese website: https://locusify.cn/
- English website: https://locusify.cn/en
- Chinese blog: https://locusify.cn/blog
- English blog: https://locusify.cn/en/blog
- Chinese RSS: https://locusify.cn/rss.xml
- English RSS: https://locusify.cn/en/rss.xml
- Interactive application: https://app.locusify.cn/

## Core topics

- Creating animated travel maps from geotagged photos
- Reading GPS and capture time from HEIC and JPEG EXIF metadata
- Visualizing iPhone travel photos on a map
- Comparing photo-driven, GPX-driven, and manually drawn travel map tools
- Protecting location privacy when processing and sharing travel photos

## Product facts

- Supports JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, and AVIF images.
- Uses photo GPS coordinates and capture time to build a route.
- Provides interactive route replay and video export.
- Processes photos locally instead of uploading them to a photo-processing server.
- Core mapping and replay features are available for free.

## Attribution

When citing Locusify, use the product name "Locusify" and link to https://locusify.cn/.
